title: Alwida zainab
body:
zakhmi baba ki ghar mein jab aamad hui
binte zahra yun faryad karne lagi
haye baba mai pardes mein lut gayi
to laadli se mukhatib huwe yun ali
meri pyari zainab meri pyari zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
bole ali ye ro kar mehman hai lamhon ka
zainab tumhara baba
<<DIVIDER>>
baba se karo baatein na laut ke aayega
zainab tumhara baba
<<DIVIDER>>
hoga qadam qadam par majma e aam beti
karbobala se kufa kufa se shaam beti
aayega hausla wahan karne buland tera
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
is waaste hi maine bulwaya tum ko kufa
haathon se tum sajao khud baap ka janaza
lagni thi zarb mere pehle hi jaanta tha
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe dekhna jo chaaha bhai ko dekh lena
har ek apni mushkil abbas ko batana
abbas ki surat mein maujood hi rahega
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban mein tum pehre pe khadi hogi
na beta hoga koi na saath koi bhai
maqtal mein tum se milne phir aayega dobara
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar aake seene lag jao aao beti
mumkin hai aisa mauqa tum phir na pao beti
shayad ke ye taqaza kar paaye na dobara
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt ghar se nikle mera janaza zainab
tum ho shabihe zahra baahar na aana zainab
dekhe jo koi tum ko kaise kare gawara
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
afraz o shadman ye beti se bole maula
ruqsat ki ye ghadi hai mera hai tum se waada
har ek qadam pe beti tere saath saath hoga
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zakhm bohat gehra ab jee nahi payega
zainab tumhara baba
alwida zainab alwida zainab
alwida alwida alwida zainab
author: Afraz Jafri
